## 01dfed2930fa

**Reproduced teaching ambiguity; target left unchanged.** Generator SHA-256 `5caaf2af55a4474f2b14c8d7d31ea5544d799afb1e447bf2a198718ec7fea943`; rule hash `f4fc416972b0`.

For seed `0`, difficulty `easy`, ordinary sample indices `4`, `5`, and `6` contain no room with multiple seed colors. A plausible rival—fill every seeded room using only its first row-major seed color—matches the authoritative output on all three demonstrations. Ordinary sample index `7` contains a mixed-seed room; the authoritative rule preserves the mixed behavior while the rival does not, so the query differs. All four inputs pass the target validator and belong to the documented default-sampler domain.

The complete hash-bound reproducer is `checks/audit/01dfed2930fa/counterexample.json`; supported Racket execution is retained in `checks/audit/01dfed2930fa/racket.json`. This is a lesson-assembly defect even though every individual label is valid: an unscheduled random texture choice can leave all demonstrations unable to teach the mixed-seed branch.

## 01dfed2930fa

**Reproduced teaching ambiguity; target left unchanged.** Current generator SHA-256 `5caaf2af55a4474f2b14c8d7d31ea5544d799afb1e447bf2a198718ec7fea943`; executed rule hash `f4fc416972b0`.

Using seed `0`, difficulty `easy`, and ordinary sample indices `4,5,6,7`, all four generated inputs pass `self_check`. A plausible rival fills every seeded room with its first row-major seed color. It matches the authoritative Racket output on indices `4,5,6`, because those demonstrations contain no two-color room, then differs on query index `7`, which contains seed colors 7 and 9 in one room. Thus three legal, correctly labeled demonstrations fail to teach the rule's distinct-color gate.

Current-source replay: `checks/audit/01dfed2930fa/counterexample-current.json`; Racket application metadata/output: `checks/audit/01dfed2930fa/racket-current.json`; replay script: `checks/audit/01dfed2930fa/reproduce.py`. The generated inputs exactly matched the retained input file, rival match vector was `[true,true,true,false]`, and no validator errors occurred. The separate strict audit preset also failed because the target declares no semantic contract: `checks/audit/01dfed2930fa-combined/result.json`.
